difficulty_reason: For Z -> X formally unramified between spaces over S, the universal first order thickening Z' -> X is formally unramified. The retained proof is complete and written in the elementwise lifting form: given a first order thickening T ⊂ T' of affine schemes over X with two maps a, b : T' -> Z' agreeing on T (c = a|_T), form the scheme-theoretic inverse images T_0 = c^{-1}(Z) and T'_a = a^{-1}(Z); the transitivity observations (T' a first order thickening of T'_a; T_0 = T x T'_a; hence T'_a a first order thickening of T_0 inside T) let one apply the universal property of Z' to a|_{T'_a}, b|_{T'_a} over T_0, forcing a = b on T'_a, then once more over T'_a to conclude a = b on T' — exactly the defining property of formally unramified. Retained author proof at lines 3192-3215.

dedup.scope: Formal unramifiedness descends from Z to its universal first order thickening over X (spaces).
